description: The formulas of the propagation of uncertainty (Wikipedia: Propagation_of_uncertainty): the variance of a function of uncertain inputs for a scaled quantity, a sum, a difference, a linear combination, a product and a quotient, each in the variance form that the calculation engine can reproduce, plus the standard deviation forms of the example table (power, logarithm, exponential, trigonometric function, general power and root) and the first order formula as documentation. The sample inputs x = 3 and y = 2 with the standard deviations 0.3 and 0.4, the correlation 0.2 and the coefficients a = 2 and b = 5 are assumed to make every variance formula reproducible by a calc-validation.

the standard deviation of the input x
the standard deviation of the input y
the standard deviation of the result f
the variance of the input x, the square of its standard deviation
the variance of the input y, the square of its standard deviation
the variance of the result f, the square of its standard deviation
the covariance of the inputs x and y, zero if the inputs are independent

formulas.name: variance from the standard deviation
formulas.expression: "variance of x" = "sigma of x" * "sigma of x"

formulas.name: covariance from the correlation
formulas.expression: "covariance of x and y" = "correlation coefficient" * "sigma of x" * "sigma of y"

formulas.name: propagation for a scaled quantity
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "a" * "a" * "variance of x"

formulas.name: propagation for a sum
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "variance of x" + "variance of y" + 2 * "covariance of x and y"

formulas.name: propagation for a difference
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "variance of x" + "variance of y" - 2 * "covariance of x and y"

formulas.name: propagation for a linear combination
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "a" * "a" * "variance of x" + "b" * "b" * "variance of y" + 2 * "a" * "b" * "covariance of x and y"

formulas.name: propagation for a linear difference
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "a" * "a" * "variance of x" + "b" * "b" * "variance of y" - 2 * "a" * "b" * "covariance of x and y"

formulas.name: propagation for a product
formulas.description: f = x y, first order approximation
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "x" * "y" * "x" * "y" * ( "variance of x" / ( "x" * "x" ) + "variance of y" / ( "y" * "y" ) + 2 * "covariance of x and y" / ( "x" * "y" ) )

formulas.name: propagation for a quotient
formulas.description: f = x / y, first order approximation
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = ( "x" / "y" ) * ( "x" / "y" ) * ( "variance of x" / ( "x" * "x" ) + "variance of y" / ( "y" * "y" ) - 2 * "covariance of x and y" / ( "x" * "y" ) )

formulas.name: exact variance of a product
formulas.description: f = x y for independent inputs, exact instead of the first order approximation (Goodman)
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = "x" * "x" * "variance of y" + "y" * "y" * "variance of x" + "variance of x" * "variance of y"

formulas.name: standard deviation of the result
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = sqrt("variance of f")

formulas.name: propagation for a ratio to the sum
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("f" / ("x" + "y")) * sqrt("y"^2 / "x"^2 * "variance of x" + "variance of y" - 2 * "y" / "x" * "covariance of x and y")

formulas.name: propagation for a power
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("f" * "b" * "sigma of x" / "x")

formulas.name: propagation for a natural logarithm
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("a" * "sigma of x" / "x")

formulas.name: propagation for a decimal logarithm
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("a" * "sigma of x" / ("x" * ln(10)))

formulas.name: propagation for an exponential
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("f" * "b" * "sigma of x")

formulas.name: propagation for a general exponential
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("f" * "b" * ln("a") * "sigma of x")

formulas.name: propagation for a sine
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("a" * "b" * cos("b" * "x") * "sigma of x")

formulas.name: propagation for a cosine
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("a" * "b" * sin("b" * "x") * "sigma of x")

formulas.name: propagation for a tangent
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("a" * "b" * sec("b" * "x")^2 * "sigma of x")

formulas.name: propagation for a general power
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = abs("f") * sqrt(("y" * "sigma of x" / "x")^2 + (ln("x") * "sigma of y")^2 + 2 * "y" * ln("x") * "covariance of x and y" / "x")

formulas.name: propagation for a root of a sum of squares
formulas.description: f = sqrt(a x^2 + b y^2), for a difference of the squares the sign of the covariance term flips
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = sqrt(("x" / "f")^2 * "a"^2 * "variance of x" + ("y" / "f")^2 * "b"^2 * "variance of y" + 2 * "a" * "b" * "x" * "y" * "covariance of x and y" / "f"^2)

formulas.name: propagation to the first order
formulas.description: the variance of any function f of the independent inputs x_i to the first order of the Taylor expansion
formulas.expression: "variance of f" = sum((d"f"/d"x"_"i")^2 * "variance of x"_"i", "i"=1.."n")

formulas.name: standard error of the mean
formulas.description: the standard deviation of the mean of n independent measurements with the standard deviation sigma
formulas.expression: "sigma of f" = "sigma" / sqrt("n")
